g.title: KEX
g.text: Both: recv peer's KexPub → derive wrap_key + meta_key
KexPub so it doesn't blast into an empty room)

g.title: NOTE_KEX
g.text: Same KEX serves any chunk-transport pick.
Mode change (Auto → Relay) does NOT re-KEX.

g.title: M_AUTO
g.text: switch chunk path to Relay HTTP.

g.title: M_PARALLEL
g.text: Both Webrtc DC and Relay HTTP

g.title: NOTE_PARALLEL
g.text: up to 2× at chunk phase (both paths carry same idx).
